extracted.name: Classic Crab and Shrimp Salad
extracted.description: A classic seafood combination of crab meat and cooked shrimp is combined with chopped bell pepper, celery, and fresh dill in a simple mayonnaise dressing that lets seafood flavors shine.
ingredient_lines: 6 ounces fresh crabmeat, drained and flaked
1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place crabmeat, shrimp, onion, bell pepper, and celery into a bowl. Gently stir in mayonnaise, dill, and Worcestershire sauce until combined; season with salt and black pepper. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
